title: Talking About Last Weekend
context: People often start a conversation by asking about the weekend. Use the past simple to say what you did, and short adjectives to say how it was.
contextPersian: مردم اغلب گفتگو را با پرسیدن دربارهٔ آخر هفته شروع می‌کنند. از گذشتهٔ ساده برای گفتن کارهایی که کردی و از صفت‌های کوتاه برای گفتن اینکه چطور بود استفاده کن.

expressions.english: What did you do at the weekend?
expressions.example: What did you do at the weekend? — Not much, I stayed at home.
expressions.examplePersian: آخر هفته چه کردی؟ — چیز خاصی نه، خانه ماندم.
expressions.note: On weekends / at the weekend: BrE says at the weekend.

expressions.example: I stayed at home and watched a film.
expressions.examplePersian: خانه ماندم و یک فیلم دیدم.

expressions.example: I went to the mountains with some friends.
expressions.examplePersian: با چند دوست به کوه رفتم.

expressions.english: We met some friends for lunch.
expressions.persian: با چند دوست برای ناهار قرار گذاشتیم.
expressions.example: We met some friends for lunch and then walked in the park.
expressions.examplePersian: با چند دوست ناهار خوردیم و بعد در پارک قدم زدیم.

expressions.english: I had a really good time.
expressions.example: I had a really good time at the party.
expressions.note: Have a good time = enjoy yourself.

expressions.english: It was great. / It was awful.
expressions.example: The film was great, but the food was awful.
expressions.examplePersian: فیلم عالی بود اما غذا افتضاح بود.

expressions.example: The trip was a bit boring, to be honest.
I didn't do much. I just relaxed.
expressions.examplePersian: کار خاصی نکردم. فقط استراحت کردم.
expressions.note: After didn't use the base verb: didn't do, didn't go.

expressions.example: How was your trip to Shiraz? — It was amazing!
expressions.examplePersian: سفرت به شیراز چطور بود؟ — فوق‌العاده بود!

expressions.example: Did you enjoy the concert? — Yes, very much.
expressions.examplePersian: از کنسرت لذت بردی؟ — بله، خیلی.

expressions.example: I spent the whole day cleaning the flat.
expressions.examplePersian: تمام روز را صرف تمیز کردن خانه کردم.

expressions.example: We got back late on Sunday night, so I was tired on Monday.
expressions.examplePersian: شب یکشنبه دیر برگشتیم، برای همین دوشنبه خسته بودم.

options: I went to the cinema on Saturday.
I go to the cinema on Saturday yesterday.
I goed to the cinema on Saturday.
I was go to the cinema on Saturday.

commonErrors.feedback: After didn't we use the base verb: didn't do.
commonErrors.feedbackPersian: بعد از didn't فعل ساده می‌آید: didn't do.

exercises.after: some friends for lunch on Saturday.

targets: I had a really good time.
exercises.explanation: have a good time = enjoy yourself
exercises.explanationPersian: have a good time یعنی خوش گذشت.

targets: What did you do at the weekend?
acceptedAnswers: What did you do at the weekend?
What did you do on the weekend?
What did you do last weekend?
What did you do this weekend?

commonErrors.feedback: After 'did' we use the base verb: What did you do?
commonErrors.feedbackPersian: بعد از did فعل ساده می‌آید: What did you do؟

exercises.source: خانه ماندم و یک فیلم دیدم.
acceptedAnswers: I stayed at home and watched a film.
I stayed home and watched a film.
I stayed at home and watched a movie.
I stayed home and watched a movie.
I stayed in and watched a film.

commonErrors.feedback: Keep the order of events: I stayed at home and watched a film.

acceptedAnswers: I did not do anything special.

exercises.prompt: Sara says: "On Saturday I went to the mountains. On Sunday I stayed at home and slept." Where did Sara go on Saturday?

exercises.incorrectSentence: Yesterday I go to the park.
acceptedAnswers: Yesterday I went to the park.

exercises.incorrectSentence: I didn't went anywhere at the weekend.
acceptedAnswers: I didn't go anywhere at the weekend.
I did not go anywhere at the weekend.

speakingTask.instruction: Tell a friend what you did last weekend and how it was.
speakingTask.instructionPersian: به یک دوست بگو آخر هفتهٔ گذشته چه کردی و چطور بود.
modelSentences: I went to the mountains with some friends.
We had a really good time.
The food was great, but the weather was a bit cold.
On Sunday I stayed at home and relaxed.

roleplay.objective: Talk about your weekend and ask your colleague about theirs
roleplay.context: It is Monday morning and a colleague asks about your weekend. Say what you did and how it was. Then ask them what they did. Use the past simple.
roleplay.opening: Morning! Did you have a good weekend? What did you do?
